name: Write a personal launch-day message to every interested reader with an AI copywriter
description: On launch day, writes every interested reader a personal message that mentions the story they commented on. The author approves each batch, then sends it by hand, since the networks do not allow automated replies to comments.
shortDescription: On launch day, draft a personal message for every reader who asked about the book.
keyFeatures: Loads interested readers from a data table
AI copywriter that mentions the story each reader commented on
Writes all messages to a Google Doc for the author to review and send
prerequisites: The interested readers data table filled by the comment tracker template; replace REPLACE_WITH_INTERESTED_READERS_TABLE
Replace REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN with your shop's address
idealFor: Authors launching a book to readers who already asked for it.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually on launch day.
Load the interested readers from the data table.
The copywriter agent writes a personal message for each reader.
Write the messages to a new Google Doc.
